            '.c': 'C',
            '.h': 'C',
            '.cpp': 'C++',
            '.cc': 'C++',
            '.cxx': 'C++',
            '.hpp': 'C++',
            '.py': 'Python',
            '.java': 'Java',
            '.js': 'JavaScript',
            '.ts': 'TypeScript',
            '.rs': 'Rust',
            '.go': 'Go',
            '.rb': 'Ruby',
            '.php': 'PHP',
            '.pl': 'Perl',
        }
        
        if ext in ext_map:
            return ext_map[ext]
        
        # Special patterns
        if name in ('makefile', 'cmake.txt') or name.endswith('makefile'):
            return 'Make'
        
        return None
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_c_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse C/C++ file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        # Simple C parsing with regex
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            # Function definitions
            func_match = re.match(r'^\s*(static\s+)?(inline\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*\(', line)
            if func_match:
                func_name = func_match.group(4)
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='f',
                    typeref=None
                ))
            
            # Variable definitions at file scope
            var_match = re.match(r'^\s*(static\s+|extern\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*[=;]', line)
            if var_match and 'typedef' not in line and 'struct' not in line:
                var_name = var_match.group(3)
                if var_name not in [t.name for t in tags]:  # Avoid duplicates
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=line.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
            
            # Struct definitions
            struct_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+struct\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if struct_match and struct_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=struct_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='s'
                ))
            
            # Macro definitions
            macro_match = re.match(r'#define\s+(\w+)', line)
            if macro_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=macro_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='d'
                ))
            
            # Typedef definitions
            typedef_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef\s+(\w+)\s+(\w+)', line)
            if typedef_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=typedef_match.group(2),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='t'
                ))
            
            # Enum definitions
            enum_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+enum\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if enum_match and enum_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=enum_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),

                ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_python_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse Python file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            
            # Class definitions
            class_match = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', stripped)
            if class_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=class_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind='c'
                ))
            
            # Function/method definitions
            def_match = re.match(r'^def\s+(\w+)\s*\(', stripped)
            if def_match:
                func_name = def_match.group(1)
                # Determine if it's a method (indented) or function
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                kind = 'm' if indent > 0 else 'f'
                
                scope = None
                scope_kind = None
                if kind == 'm':
                    # Find the class this method belongs to
                    for j in range(i-2, -1, -1):
                        if lines[j].lstrip().startswith('class '):
                            class_match_inner = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', lines[j].lstrip())
                            if class_match_inner:
                                scope = class_match_inner.group(1)
                                scope_kind = 'c'
                            break
                
                tag = Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind=kind,
                    scope=scope,
                    scope_kind=scope_kind
                )
                tags.append(tag)
            
            # Variable assignments at module level
            var_match = re.match(r'^(\w+)\s*=', stripped)
            if var_match and not stripped.startswith('def ') and not stripped.startswith('class '):
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                if indent == 0:  # Module level only
                    var_name = var_match.group(1)
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_file(filename: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse a file for tags"""
        if not os.path.isfile(filename):
            return []
        
        if language is None:
            language = LanguageSupport.detect_language(filename)
        
        if language is None:
            return []
        
        if language == 'C' or language == 'C++':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_c_file(filename)
        elif language == 'Python':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_python_file(filename)
        
        return []

class CtagsContext:
    """Main ctags context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.input_files: List[str] = []
        self.output_file: str = "tags"
        self.output_format: OutputFormat = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
        self.sort_mode: SortMode = SortMode.YES
        self.excmd_mode: ExcmdMode = ExcmdMode.MIX
        self.tag_format: int = 2
        self.recurse: bool = False
        self.append: bool = False
        self.verbose: bool = False
        self.language_force: Optional[str] = None
        self.fields: Optional[str] = None
        self.tags: List[Tag] = []
        self.cwd = os.getcwd()
    
    def add_input_file(self, filename: str):
        """Add an input file"""
        if os.path.isfile(filename):
            self.input_files.append(filename)
        elif os.path.isdir(filename) and self.recurse:
            self.add_directory(filename)
    
    def add_directory(self, directory: str):
        """Recursively add files from directory"""
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
            for file in files:
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                self.input_files.append(filepath)
    
    def process_files(self):
        """Process all input files and extract tags"""
        for filename in self.input_files:
            try:
                tags = LanguageSupport.parse_file(filename, self.language_force)
                self.tags.extend(tags)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.verbose:
                    print(f"Error processing {filename}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    
    def sort_tags(self):
        """Sort tags according to sort mode"""
        if self.sort_mode == SortMode.YES:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name)
        elif self.sort_mode == SortMode.FOLDCASE:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name.lower())
    
    def output_tags(self):
        """Output tags in specified format"""
        self.sort_tags()
        
        if self.output_format == OutputFormat.UCTAGS:
            self._output_uctags()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.JSON:
            self._output_json()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.XREF:
            self._output_xref()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.ETAGS:
            self._output_etags()
    
    def _output_uctags(self):
        """Output in Universal Ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Write pseudo-tags if writing to file
        if self.output_file != '-':
            pseudo_tags = self._get_pseudo_tags()
            for pseudo_tag in pseudo_tags:
                output_file.write(pseudo_tag + '\n')
        
        # Write regular tags
        for tag in self.tags:
            line = f"{tag.name}\t{tag.file}\t/^{self._escape_pattern(tag.pattern)}$/;\"\t{tag.kind}"
            
            if tag.typeref:
                line += f"\ttyperef:typename:{tag.typeref}"
            if tag.scope:
                line += f"\t{tag.scope_kind}:{tag.scope}"
            
            output_file.write(line + '\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_json(self):
        """Output in JSON format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        tags_list = [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags]
        json.dump(tags_list, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write('\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_xref(self):
        """Output in xref format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        for tag in self.tags:
            output_file.write(f"{tag.kind} {tag.name:<20} {tag.file:<30} {tag.line}\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_etags(self):
        """Output in Emacs ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Group tags by file
        tags_by_file = {}
        for tag in self.tags:
            if tag.file not in tags_by_file:
                tags_by_file[tag.file] = []
            tags_by_file[tag.file].append(tag)
        
        for filename in sorted(tags_by_file.keys()):
            try:
                with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except:
                continue
            
            output_file.write(f"\x0c\n{filename},{len(content)}\n")
            
            for tag in tags_by_file[filename]:
                # Find the tag in the file
                lines = content.split('\n')
                if tag.line <= len(lines):
                    line_content = lines[tag.line - 1]
                    output_file.write(f"{line_content}\x7f{tag.name}\x01{tag.line},0\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _get_pseudo_tags(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate pseudo tags header"""
        pseudo = []
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_FORMAT\t2\t/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;\" to lines/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_SORTED\t1\t/0=unsorted, 1=sorted, 2=foldcase/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_MODE\tu-ctags\t/u-ctags or e-ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_EXCMD\tmixed\t/number, pattern, mixed, or combineV2/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_VERSION\t1.1\t/current.age/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PATTERN_LENGTH_LIMIT\t96\t/0 for no limit/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROC_CWD\t/workspace/\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_AUTHOR\tUniversal Ctags Team\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_NAME\tUniversal Ctags\t/Derived from Exuberant Ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_URL\thttps://ctags.io/\t/official site/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_VERSION\t6.2.0\t/d922013/")
        
        # Add kind descriptions for C
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\td,macro\t/macro definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\te,enumerator\t/enumerators (values inside an enumeration)/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tf,function\t/function definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tg,enum\t/enumeration names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\th,header\t/included header files/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tm,member\t/struct, and union members/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\ts,struct\t/structure names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tt,typedef\t/typedefs/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tu,union\t/union names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tv,variable\t/variable definitions/")
        
        # Add field descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tinput\t/input file/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tname\t/tag name/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tpattern\t/pattern/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\ttyperef\t/Type and name of a variable or typedef/")
        
        # Add extra descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tanonymous\t/Include tags for non-named objects like lambda/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tfileScope\t/Include tags of file scope/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tpseudo\t/Include pseudo tags/")
        
        # Add role descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigncall\t/called in foreign languages/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigndecl\t/declared in foreign languages/")
        
        return pseudo
    
    def _escape_pattern(self, pattern: str) -> str:
        """Escape pattern for tag file"""
        return pattern.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('/', '\\/')

import sys

@dataclass
class Tag:

    line: int
    pattern: str
    kind: str

    scope: Optional[str] = None
    scope_kind: Optional[str] = None

class LanguageSupport:
    """Base class for language support"""
    
    LANGUAGES = {}
    
    @staticmethod
    def detect_language(filename: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Detect language from filename"""
        ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        name = Path(filename).name.lower()
        
        # Extension mappings
        ext_map = {
            '.c': 'C',
            '.h': 'C',
            '.cpp': 'C++',
            '.cc': 'C++',
            '.cxx': 'C++',
            '.hpp': 'C++',
            '.py': 'Python',
            '.java': 'Java',
            '.js': 'JavaScript',
            '.ts': 'TypeScript',
            '.rs': 'Rust',
            '.go': 'Go',
            '.rb': 'Ruby',
            '.php': 'PHP',
            '.pl': 'Perl',
        }
        
        if ext in ext_map:
            return ext_map[ext]
        
        # Special patterns
        if name in ('makefile', 'cmake.txt') or name.endswith('makefile'):
            return 'Make'
        
        return None
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_c_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse C/C++ file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        # Simple C parsing with regex
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            # Function definitions
            func_match = re.match(r'^\s*(static\s+)?(inline\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*\(', line)
            if func_match:
                func_name = func_match.group(4)
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='f',
                    typeref=None
                ))
            
            # Variable definitions at file scope
            var_match = re.match(r'^\s*(static\s+|extern\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*[=;]', line)
            if var_match and 'typedef' not in line and 'struct' not in line:
                var_name = var_match.group(3)
                if var_name not in [t.name for t in tags]:  # Avoid duplicates
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=line.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
            
            # Struct definitions
            struct_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+struct\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if struct_match and struct_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=struct_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='s'
                ))
            
            # Macro definitions
            macro_match = re.match(r'#define\s+(\w+)', line)
            if macro_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=macro_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='d'
                ))
            
            # Typedef definitions
            typedef_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef\s+(\w+)\s+(\w+)', line)
            if typedef_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=typedef_match.group(2),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='t'
                ))
            
            # Enum definitions
            enum_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+enum\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if enum_match and enum_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=enum_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='g'
                ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_python_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse Python file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            
            # Class definitions
            class_match = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', stripped)
            if class_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=class_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind='c'
                ))
            
            # Function/method definitions
            def_match = re.match(r'^def\s+(\w+)\s*\(', stripped)
            if def_match:
                func_name = def_match.group(1)
                # Determine if it's a method (indented) or function
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                kind = 'm' if indent > 0 else 'f'
                
                scope = None
                scope_kind = None
                if kind == 'm':
                    # Find the class this method belongs to
                    for j in range(i-2, -1, -1):
                        if lines[j].lstrip().startswith('class '):
                            class_match_inner = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', lines[j].lstrip())
                            if class_match_inner:
                                scope = class_match_inner.group(1)
                                scope_kind = 'c'
                            break
                
                tag = Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind=kind,
                    scope=scope,
                    scope_kind=scope_kind
                )
                tags.append(tag)
            
            # Variable assignments at module level
            var_match = re.match(r'^(\w+)\s*=', stripped)
            if var_match and not stripped.startswith('def ') and not stripped.startswith('class '):
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                if indent == 0:  # Module level only
                    var_name = var_match.group(1)
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_file(filename: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse a file for tags"""
        if not os.path.isfile(filename):
            return []
        
        if language is None:
            language = LanguageSupport.detect_language(filename)
        
        if language is None:
            return []
        
        if language == 'C' or language == 'C++':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_c_file(filename)
        elif language == 'Python':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_python_file(filename)
        
        return []

class CtagsContext:
    """Main ctags context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.input_files: List[str] = []
        self.output_file: str = "tags"
        self.output_format: OutputFormat = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
        self.sort_mode: SortMode = SortMode.YES
        self.excmd_mode: ExcmdMode = ExcmdMode.MIX
        self.tag_format: int = 2
        self.recurse: bool = False
        self.append: bool = False
        self.verbose: bool = False
        self.language_force: Optional[str] = None
        self.fields: Optional[str] = None
        self.tags: List[Tag] = []
        self.cwd = os.getcwd()
    
    def add_input_file(self, filename: str):
        """Add an input file"""
        if os.path.isfile(filename):
            self.input_files.append(filename)
        elif os.path.isdir(filename) and self.recurse:
            self.add_directory(filename)
    
    def add_directory(self, directory: str):
        """Recursively add files from directory"""
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
            for file in files:
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                self.input_files.append(filepath)
    
    def process_files(self):
        """Process all input files and extract tags"""
        for filename in self.input_files:
            try:
                tags = LanguageSupport.parse_file(filename, self.language_force)
                self.tags.extend(tags)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.verbose:
                    print(f"Error processing {filename}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    
    def sort_tags(self):
        """Sort tags according to sort mode"""
        if self.sort_mode == SortMode.YES:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name)
        elif self.sort_mode == SortMode.FOLDCASE:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name.lower())
    
    def output_tags(self):
        """Output tags in specified format"""
        self.sort_tags()
        
        if self.output_format == OutputFormat.UCTAGS:
            self._output_uctags()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.JSON:
            self._output_json()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.XREF:
            self._output_xref()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.ETAGS:
            self._output_etags()
    
    def _output_uctags(self):
        """Output in Universal Ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Write pseudo-tags if writing to file
        if self.output_file != '-':
            pseudo_tags = self._get_pseudo_tags()
            for pseudo_tag in pseudo_tags:
                output_file.write(pseudo_tag + '\n')
        
        # Write regular tags
        for tag in self.tags:
            line = f"{tag.name}\t{tag.file}\t/^{self._escape_pattern(tag.pattern)}$/;\"\t{tag.kind}"
            
            if tag.typeref:
                line += f"\ttyperef:typename:{tag.typeref}"
            if tag.scope:
                line += f"\t{tag.scope_kind}:{tag.scope}"
            
            output_file.write(line + '\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_json(self):
        """Output in JSON format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        tags_list = [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags]
        json.dump(tags_list, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write('\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_xref(self):
        """Output in xref format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        for tag in self.tags:
            output_file.write(f"{tag.kind} {tag.name:<20} {tag.file:<30} {tag.line}\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_etags(self):
        """Output in Emacs ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Group tags by file
        tags_by_file = {}
        for tag in self.tags:
            if tag.file not in tags_by_file:
                tags_by_file[tag.file] = []
            tags_by_file[tag.file].append(tag)
        
        for filename in sorted(tags_by_file.keys()):
            try:
                with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except:
                continue
            
            output_file.write(f"\x0c\n{filename},{len(content)}\n")
            
            for tag in tags_by_file[filename]:
                # Find the tag in the file
                lines = content.split('\n')
                if tag.line <= len(lines):
                    line_content = lines[tag.line - 1]
                    output_file.write(f"{line_content}\x7f{tag.name}\x01{tag.line},0\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _get_pseudo_tags(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate pseudo tags header"""
        pseudo = []
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_FORMAT\t2\t/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;\" to lines/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_SORTED\t1\t/0=unsorted, 1=sorted, 2=foldcase/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_VERSION\t6.2.0\t/d922013/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\ts,struct\t/structure names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tt,typedef\t/typedefs/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tu,union\t/union names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tv,variable\t/variable definitions/")
        
        # Add field descriptions

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigndecl\t/declared in foreign languages/")
        
        return pseudo
    
    def _escape_pattern(self, pattern: str) -> str:
        """Escape pattern for tag file"""
        return pattern.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('/', '\\/')

        """Parse C/C++ file"""

            if var_match and 'typedef' not in line and 'struct' not in line:

                if var_name not in [t.name for t in tags]:  # Avoid duplicates

                    kind=kind,
                    scope=scope,
                    scope_kind=scope_kind
                )
                tags.append(tag)
            
            # Variable assignments at module level
            var_match = re.match(r'^(\w+)\s*=', stripped)
            if var_match and not stripped.startswith('def ') and not stripped.startswith('class '):
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                if indent == 0:  # Module level only
                    var_name = var_match.group(1)
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_file(filename: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse a file for tags"""
        if not os.path.isfile(filename):
            return []
        
        if language is None:
            language = LanguageSupport.detect_language(filename)
        
        if language is None:
            return []
        
        if language == 'C' or language == 'C++':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_c_file(filename)
        elif language == 'Python':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_python_file(filename)
        
        return []

class CtagsContext:
    """Main ctags context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.input_files: List[str] = []
        self.output_file: str = "tags"
        self.output_format: OutputFormat = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
        self.sort_mode: SortMode = SortMode.YES
        self.excmd_mode: ExcmdMode = ExcmdMode.MIX
        self.tag_format: int = 2
        self.recurse: bool = False
        self.append: bool = False
        self.verbose: bool = False
        self.language_force: Optional[str] = None
        self.fields: Optional[str] = None
        self.tags: List[Tag] = []
        self.cwd = os.getcwd()
    
    def add_input_file(self, filename: str):
        """Add an input file"""
        if os.path.isfile(filename):
            self.input_files.append(filename)
        elif os.path.isdir(filename) and self.recurse:
            self.add_directory(filename)
    
    def add_directory(self, directory: str):
        """Recursively add files from directory"""
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
            for file in files:
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                self.input_files.append(filepath)
    
    def process_files(self):
        """Process all input files and extract tags"""
        for filename in self.input_files:
            try:
                tags = LanguageSupport.parse_file(filename, self.language_force)
                self.tags.extend(tags)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.verbose:
                    print(f"Error processing {filename}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    
    def sort_tags(self):
        """Sort tags according to sort mode"""
        if self.sort_mode == SortMode.YES:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name)
        elif self.sort_mode == SortMode.FOLDCASE:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name.lower())
    
    def output_tags(self):
        """Output tags in specified format"""
        self.sort_tags()
        
        if self.output_format == OutputFormat.UCTAGS:
            self._output_uctags()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.JSON:
            self._output_json()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.XREF:
            self._output_xref()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.ETAGS:
            self._output_etags()
    
    def _output_uctags(self):
        """Output in Universal Ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Write pseudo-tags if writing to file
        if self.output_file != '-':
            pseudo_tags = self._get_pseudo_tags()
            for pseudo_tag in pseudo_tags:
                output_file.write(pseudo_tag + '\n')
        
        # Write regular tags
        for tag in self.tags:
            line = f"{tag.name}\t{tag.file}\t/^{self._escape_pattern(tag.pattern)}$/;\"\t{tag.kind}"
            
            if tag.typeref:
                line += f"\ttyperef:typename:{tag.typeref}"
            if tag.scope:
                line += f"\t{tag.scope_kind}:{tag.scope}"
            
            output_file.write(line + '\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_json(self):
        """Output in JSON format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        tags_list = [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags]
        json.dump(tags_list, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write('\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_xref(self):
        """Output in xref format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        for tag in self.tags:
            output_file.write(f"{tag.kind} {tag.name:<20} {tag.file:<30} {tag.line}\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_etags(self):
        """Output in Emacs ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Group tags by file
        tags_by_file = {}
        for tag in self.tags:
            if tag.file not in tags_by_file:
                tags_by_file[tag.file] = []
            tags_by_file[tag.file].append(tag)
        
        for filename in sorted(tags_by_file.keys()):
            try:
                with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except:
                continue
            
            output_file.write(f"\x0c\n{filename},{len(content)}\n")
            
            for tag in tags_by_file[filename]:
                # Find the tag in the file
                lines = content.split('\n')
                if tag.line <= len(lines):
                    line_content = lines[tag.line - 1]
                    output_file.write(f"{line_content}\x7f{tag.name}\x01{tag.line},0\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _get_pseudo_tags(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate pseudo tags header"""
        pseudo = []
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_FORMAT\t2\t/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;\" to lines/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_SORTED\t1\t/0=unsorted, 1=sorted, 2=foldcase/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tf,function\t/function definitions/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\th,header\t/included header files/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\ts,struct\t/structure names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tt,typedef\t/typedefs/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tu,union\t/union names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tv,variable\t/variable definitions/")
        
        # Add field descriptions

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tname\t/tag name/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tpattern\t/pattern/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\ttyperef\t/Type and name of a variable or typedef/")
        
        # Add extra descriptions

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tfileScope\t/Include tags of file scope/")

        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigndecl\t/declared in foreign languages/")
        
        return pseudo
    
    def _escape_pattern(self, pattern: str) -> str:
        """Escape pattern for tag file"""
        return pattern.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('/', '\\/')

    if args.output_file2:
        ctx.output_file = args.output_file2

        ctx.output_file = args.output_file
    
    # Set options

    ctx.append = args.append
    ctx.verbose = args.verbose
    ctx.language_force = args.language_force
    ctx.fields = args.fields
    
    # Set output format
    if args.emacs:
        ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.ETAGS
    elif args.xref:
        ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.XREF
    elif args.output_format:
        if args.output_format == 'json':
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.JSON
        elif args.output_format in ['etags', 'e-ctags']:
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.ETAGS
        elif args.output_format == 'xref':
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.XREF
        else:
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
    
    # Set sort mode
    if args.nosort:
        ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.NO
    elif args.sort_mode:
        if args.sort_mode == 'foldcase':
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.FOLDCASE
        elif args.sort_mode == 'no':
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.NO
        else:
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.YES
    
    # Add input files
    for filename in args.files:
        ctx.add_input_file(filename)
    
    # Process and output
    if ctx.input_files:
        ctx.process_files()
        ctx.output_tags()
    
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

        except:
            return tags
        
        # Track brace depth to know if we're at file scope
        brace_depth = 0
        in_function = False
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.strip()
            
            # Update brace depth
            for char in line:
                if char == '{':
                    if brace_depth == 0 and not in_function:
                        in_function = True
                    brace_depth += 1
                elif char == '}':
                    brace_depth -= 1
                    if brace_depth == 0:
                        in_function = False
            
            # Only parse at file scope (brace_depth == 0)
            if brace_depth > 0:
                continue
            
            # Function definitions (must be at file scope)
            func_match = re.match(r'^(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*\(', line)
            if func_match and not line.strip().startswith('//') and not line.strip().startswith('*'):
                func_name = func_match.group(2)
                if func_name not in ['if', 'while', 'for', 'switch']:  # Avoid keywords
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=func_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=line.rstrip(),
                        kind='f',
                        typeref=None
                    ))
            
            # Variable definitions at file scope
            if not in_function:
                var_match = re.match(r'^(static\s+|extern\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*[=;]', line)
                if var_match and 'typedef' not in line and 'struct' not in line and 'enum' not in line:
                    var_name = var_match.group(3)
                    # Skip if already in tags
                    if var_name not in [t.name for t in tags]:
                        tags.append(Tag(
                            name=var_name,
                            file=filename,
                            line=i,
                            pattern=line.rstrip(),
                            kind='v'
                        ))
            
            # Struct definitions
            struct_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+struct\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if struct_match and struct_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=struct_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='s'
                ))
            
            # Macro definitions
            macro_match = re.match(r'^#define\s+(\w+)', line)
            if macro_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=macro_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='d'
                ))
            
            # Typedef definitions
            typedef_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef\s+\w+\s+(\w+)', line)
            if typedef_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=typedef_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='t'
                ))
            
            # Enum definitions
            enum_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+enum\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if enum_match and enum_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=enum_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='g'
                ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_python_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse Python file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            
            # Class definitions
            class_match = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', stripped)
            if class_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=class_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind='c'
                ))
            
            # Function/method definitions
            def_match = re.match(r'^def\s+(\w+)\s*\(', stripped)
            if def_match:
                func_name = def_match.group(1)
                # Determine if it's a method (indented) or function
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                kind = 'm' if indent > 0 else 'f'
                
                scope = None
                scope_kind = None
                if kind == 'm':
                    # Find the class this method belongs to
                    for j in range(i-2, -1, -1):
                        if lines[j].lstrip().startswith('class '):
                            class_match_inner = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', lines[j].lstrip())
                            if class_match_inner:
                                scope = class_match_inner.group(1)
                                scope_kind = 'c'
                            break
                
                tag = Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind=kind,
                    scope=scope,
                    scope_kind=scope_kind
                )
                tags.append(tag)
            
            # Variable assignments at module level
            var_match = re.match(r'^(\w+)\s*=', stripped)
            if var_match and not stripped.startswith('def ') and not stripped.startswith('class '):
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                if indent == 0:  # Module level only
                    var_name = var_match.group(1)
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_file(filename: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse a file for tags"""
        if not os.path.isfile(filename):
            return []
        
        if language is None:
            language = LanguageSupport.detect_language(filename)
        
        if language is None:
            return []
        
        if language == 'C' or language == 'C++':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_c_file(filename)
        elif language == 'Python':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_python_file(filename)
        
        return []

class CtagsContext:
    """Main ctags context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.input_files: List[str] = []
        self.output_file: str = "tags"
        self.output_format: OutputFormat = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
        self.sort_mode: SortMode = SortMode.YES
        self.excmd_mode: ExcmdMode = ExcmdMode.MIX
        self.tag_format: int = 2
        self.recurse: bool = False
        self.append: bool = False
        self.verbose: bool = False
        self.language_force: Optional[str] = None
        self.fields: Optional[str] = None
        self.tags: List[Tag] = []
        self.cwd = os.getcwd()
    
    def add_input_file(self, filename: str):
        """Add an input file"""
        if os.path.isfile(filename):
            self.input_files.append(filename)
        elif os.path.isdir(filename) and self.recurse:
            self.add_directory(filename)
    
    def add_directory(self, directory: str):
        """Recursively add files from directory"""
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
            for file in files:
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                self.input_files.append(filepath)
    
    def process_files(self):
        """Process all input files and extract tags"""
        for filename in self.input_files:
            try:
                tags = LanguageSupport.parse_file(filename, self.language_force)
                self.tags.extend(tags)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.verbose:
                    print(f"Error processing {filename}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    
    def sort_tags(self):
        """Sort tags according to sort mode"""
        if self.sort_mode == SortMode.YES:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name)
        elif self.sort_mode == SortMode.FOLDCASE:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name.lower())
    
    def output_tags(self):
        """Output tags in specified format"""
        self.sort_tags()
        
        if self.output_format == OutputFormat.UCTAGS:
            self._output_uctags()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.JSON:
            self._output_json()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.XREF:
            self._output_xref()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.ETAGS:
            self._output_etags()
    
    def _output_uctags(self):
        """Output in Universal Ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Write pseudo-tags if writing to file
        if self.output_file != '-':
            pseudo_tags = self._get_pseudo_tags()
            for pseudo_tag in pseudo_tags:
                output_file.write(pseudo_tag + '\n')
        
        # Write regular tags
        for tag in self.tags:
            line = f"{tag.name}\t{tag.file}\t/^{self._escape_pattern(tag.pattern)}$/;\"\t{tag.kind}"
            
            if tag.typeref:
                line += f"\ttyperef:typename:{tag.typeref}"
            if tag.scope:
                line += f"\t{tag.scope_kind}:{tag.scope}"
            
            output_file.write(line + '\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_json(self):
        """Output in JSON format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        tags_list = [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags]
        json.dump(tags_list, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write('\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_xref(self):
        """Output in xref format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        for tag in self.tags:
            output_file.write(f"{tag.kind} {tag.name:<20} {tag.file:<30} {tag.line}\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_etags(self):
        """Output in Emacs ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Group tags by file
        tags_by_file = {}
        for tag in self.tags:
            if tag.file not in tags_by_file:
                tags_by_file[tag.file] = []
            tags_by_file[tag.file].append(tag)
        
        for filename in sorted(tags_by_file.keys()):
            try:
                with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except:
                continue
            
            output_file.write(f"\x0c\n{filename},{len(content)}\n")
            
            for tag in tags_by_file[filename]:
                # Find the tag in the file
                lines = content.split('\n')
                if tag.line <= len(lines):
                    line_content = lines[tag.line - 1]
                    output_file.write(f"{line_content}\x7f{tag.name}\x01{tag.line},0\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _get_pseudo_tags(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate pseudo tags header"""
        pseudo = []
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_FORMAT\t2\t/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;\" to lines/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_SORTED\t1\t/0=unsorted, 1=sorted, 2=foldcase/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_MODE\tu-ctags\t/u-ctags or e-ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_EXCMD\tmixed\t/number, pattern, mixed, or combineV2/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_VERSION\t1.1\t/current.age/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PATTERN_LENGTH_LIMIT\t96\t/0 for no limit/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROC_CWD\t/workspace/\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_AUTHOR\tUniversal Ctags Team\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_NAME\tUniversal Ctags\t/Derived from Exuberant Ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_URL\thttps://ctags.io/\t/official site/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_VERSION\t6.2.0\t/d922013/")
        
        # Add kind descriptions for C
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\td,macro\t/macro definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\te,enumerator\t/enumerators (values inside an enumeration)/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tf,function\t/function definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tg,enum\t/enumeration names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\th,header\t/included header files/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tm,member\t/struct, and union members/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\ts,struct\t/structure names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tt,typedef\t/typedefs/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tu,union\t/union names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tv,variable\t/variable definitions/")
        
        # Add field descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tinput\t/input file/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tname\t/tag name/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tpattern\t/pattern/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\ttyperef\t/Type and name of a variable or typedef/")
        
        # Add extra descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tanonymous\t/Include tags for non-named objects like lambda/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tfileScope\t/Include tags of file scope/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tpseudo\t/Include pseudo tags/")
        
        # Add role descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigncall\t/called in foreign languages/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigndecl\t/declared in foreign languages/")
        
        return pseudo
    
    def _escape_pattern(self, pattern: str) -> str:
        """Escape pattern for tag file"""
        return pattern.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('/', '\\/')

    ctx.language_force = args.language_force
    ctx.fields = args.fields
    
    # Set output format
    if args.emacs:
        ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.ETAGS
    elif args.xref:
        ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.XREF
    elif args.output_format:
        if args.output_format == 'json':
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.JSON
        elif args.output_format in ['etags', 'e-ctags']:
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.ETAGS
        elif args.output_format == 'xref':
            ctx.output_format = OutputFormat.XREF
        else:

    if args.nosort:
        ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.NO

        if args.sort_mode == 'foldcase':
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.FOLDCASE
        elif args.sort_mode == 'no':
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.NO
        else:
            ctx.sort_mode = SortMode.YES

    for filename in args.files:
        ctx.add_input_file(filename)
    
    # Process and output
    if ctx.input_files:
        ctx.process_files()
        ctx.output_tags()

            '.py': 'Python',
            '.java': 'Java',
            '.js': 'JavaScript',
            '.ts': 'TypeScript',
            '.rs': 'Rust',
            '.go': 'Go',
            '.rb': 'Ruby',
            '.php': 'PHP',
            '.pl': 'Perl',
        }
        
        if ext in ext_map:
            return ext_map[ext]
        
        # Special patterns
        if name in ('makefile', 'cmake.txt') or name.endswith('makefile'):
            return 'Make'
        
        return None
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_c_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse C/C++ file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        # Track brace depth to know if we're at file scope
        brace_depth = 0
        in_function = False
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.strip()
            
            # Update brace depth
            for char in line:
                if char == '{':
                    if brace_depth == 0 and not in_function:
                        in_function = True
                    brace_depth += 1
                elif char == '}':
                    brace_depth -= 1
                    if brace_depth == 0:
                        in_function = False
            
            # Only parse at file scope (brace_depth == 0)
            if brace_depth > 0:
                continue
            
            # Function definitions (must be at file scope)
            func_match = re.match(r'^(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*\(', line)
            if func_match and not line.strip().startswith('//') and not line.strip().startswith('*'):
                func_name = func_match.group(2)
                if func_name not in ['if', 'while', 'for', 'switch']:  # Avoid keywords
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=func_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=line.rstrip(),
                        kind='f',
                        typeref=None
                    ))
            
            # Variable definitions at file scope
            if not in_function:
                var_match = re.match(r'^(static\s+|extern\s+)?(\w+[\s\*]+)+(\w+)\s*[=;]', line)
                if var_match and 'typedef' not in line and 'struct' not in line and 'enum' not in line:
                    var_name = var_match.group(3)
                    # Skip if already in tags
                    if var_name not in [t.name for t in tags]:
                        tags.append(Tag(
                            name=var_name,
                            file=filename,
                            line=i,
                            pattern=line.rstrip(),
                            kind='v'
                        ))
            
            # Struct definitions
            struct_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+struct\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if struct_match and struct_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=struct_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='s'
                ))
            
            # Macro definitions
            macro_match = re.match(r'^#define\s+(\w+)', line)
            if macro_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=macro_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='d'
                ))
            
            # Typedef definitions
            typedef_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef\s+\w+\s+(\w+)', line)
            if typedef_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=typedef_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='t'
                ))
            
            # Enum definitions
            enum_match = re.match(r'^\s*typedef?\s+enum\s+(\w+)?', line)
            if enum_match and enum_match.group(1):
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=enum_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=line.rstrip(),
                    kind='g'
                ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_python_file(filename: str) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse Python file"""
        tags = []
        try:
            with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                lines = f.readlines()
        except:
            return tags
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            
            # Class definitions
            class_match = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', stripped)
            if class_match:
                tags.append(Tag(
                    name=class_match.group(1),
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind='c'
                ))
            
            # Function/method definitions
            def_match = re.match(r'^def\s+(\w+)\s*\(', stripped)
            if def_match:
                func_name = def_match.group(1)
                # Determine if it's a method (indented) or function
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                kind = 'm' if indent > 0 else 'f'
                
                scope = None
                scope_kind = None
                if kind == 'm':
                    # Find the class this method belongs to
                    for j in range(i-2, -1, -1):
                        if lines[j].lstrip().startswith('class '):
                            class_match_inner = re.match(r'^class\s+(\w+)', lines[j].lstrip())
                            if class_match_inner:
                                scope = class_match_inner.group(1)
                                scope_kind = 'c'
                            break
                
                tag = Tag(
                    name=func_name,
                    file=filename,
                    line=i,
                    pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                    kind=kind,
                    scope=scope,
                    scope_kind=scope_kind
                )
                tags.append(tag)
            
            # Variable assignments at module level
            var_match = re.match(r'^(\w+)\s*=', stripped)
            if var_match and not stripped.startswith('def ') and not stripped.startswith('class '):
                indent = len(line) - len(stripped)
                if indent == 0:  # Module level only
                    var_name = var_match.group(1)
                    tags.append(Tag(
                        name=var_name,
                        file=filename,
                        line=i,
                        pattern=stripped.rstrip(),
                        kind='v'
                    ))
        
        return tags
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_file(filename: str, language: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Tag]:
        """Parse a file for tags"""
        if not os.path.isfile(filename):
            return []
        
        if language is None:
            language = LanguageSupport.detect_language(filename)
        
        if language is None:
            return []
        
        if language == 'C' or language == 'C++':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_c_file(filename)
        elif language == 'Python':
            return LanguageSupport.parse_python_file(filename)
        
        return []

class CtagsContext:
    """Main ctags context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.input_files: List[str] = []
        self.output_file: str = "tags"
        self.output_format: OutputFormat = OutputFormat.UCTAGS
        self.sort_mode: SortMode = SortMode.YES
        self.excmd_mode: ExcmdMode = ExcmdMode.MIX
        self.tag_format: int = 2
        self.recurse: bool = False
        self.append: bool = False
        self.verbose: bool = False
        self.language_force: Optional[str] = None
        self.fields: Optional[str] = None
        self.tags: List[Tag] = []
        self.cwd = os.getcwd()
    
    def add_input_file(self, filename: str):
        """Add an input file"""
        if os.path.isfile(filename):
            self.input_files.append(filename)
        elif os.path.isdir(filename) and self.recurse:
            self.add_directory(filename)
    
    def add_directory(self, directory: str):
        """Recursively add files from directory"""
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
            for file in files:
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                self.input_files.append(filepath)
    
    def process_files(self):
        """Process all input files and extract tags"""
        for filename in self.input_files:
            try:
                tags = LanguageSupport.parse_file(filename, self.language_force)
                self.tags.extend(tags)
            except Exception as e:
                if self.verbose:
                    print(f"Error processing {filename}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    
    def sort_tags(self):
        """Sort tags according to sort mode"""
        if self.sort_mode == SortMode.YES:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name)
        elif self.sort_mode == SortMode.FOLDCASE:
            self.tags.sort(key=lambda t: t.name.lower())
    
    def output_tags(self):
        """Output tags in specified format"""
        self.sort_tags()
        
        if self.output_format == OutputFormat.UCTAGS:
            self._output_uctags()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.JSON:
            self._output_json()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.XREF:
            self._output_xref()
        elif self.output_format == OutputFormat.ETAGS:
            self._output_etags()
    
    def _output_uctags(self):
        """Output in Universal Ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Write pseudo-tags if writing to file
        if self.output_file != '-':
            pseudo_tags = self._get_pseudo_tags()
            for pseudo_tag in pseudo_tags:
                output_file.write(pseudo_tag + '\n')
        
        # Write regular tags
        for tag in self.tags:
            line = f"{tag.name}\t{tag.file}\t/^{self._escape_pattern(tag.pattern)}$/;\"\t{tag.kind}"
            
            if tag.typeref:
                line += f"\ttyperef:typename:{tag.typeref}"
            if tag.scope:
                line += f"\t{tag.scope_kind}:{tag.scope}"
            
            output_file.write(line + '\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_json(self):
        """Output in JSON format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        tags_list = [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags]
        json.dump(tags_list, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write('\n')
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_xref(self):
        """Output in xref format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        for tag in self.tags:
            output_file.write(f"{tag.kind} {tag.name:<20} {tag.file:<30} {tag.line}\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _output_etags(self):
        """Output in Emacs ctags format"""
        output_file = sys.stdout if self.output_file == '-' else open(self.output_file, 'w' if not self.append else 'a')
        
        # Group tags by file
        tags_by_file = {}
        for tag in self.tags:
            if tag.file not in tags_by_file:
                tags_by_file[tag.file] = []
            tags_by_file[tag.file].append(tag)
        
        for filename in sorted(tags_by_file.keys()):
            try:
                with open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except:
                continue
            
            output_file.write(f"\x0c\n{filename},{len(content)}\n")
            
            for tag in tags_by_file[filename]:
                # Find the tag in the file
                lines = content.split('\n')
                if tag.line <= len(lines):
                    line_content = lines[tag.line - 1]
                    output_file.write(f"{line_content}\x7f{tag.name}\x01{tag.line},0\n")
        
        if self.output_file != '-':
            output_file.close()
    
    def _get_pseudo_tags(self) -> List[str]:
        """Generate pseudo tags header"""
        pseudo = []
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_FORMAT\t2\t/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;\" to lines/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FILE_SORTED\t1\t/0=unsorted, 1=sorted, 2=foldcase/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_MODE\tu-ctags\t/u-ctags or e-ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_EXCMD\tmixed\t/number, pattern, mixed, or combineV2/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_OUTPUT_VERSION\t1.1\t/current.age/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PATTERN_LENGTH_LIMIT\t96\t/0 for no limit/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROC_CWD\t/workspace/\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_AUTHOR\tUniversal Ctags Team\t//")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_NAME\tUniversal Ctags\t/Derived from Exuberant Ctags/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_URL\thttps://ctags.io/\t/official site/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_PROGRAM_VERSION\t6.2.0\t/d922013/")
        
        # Add kind descriptions for C
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\td,macro\t/macro definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\te,enumerator\t/enumerators (values inside an enumeration)/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tf,function\t/function definitions/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tg,enum\t/enumeration names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\th,header\t/included header files/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tm,member\t/struct, and union members/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\ts,struct\t/structure names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tt,typedef\t/typedefs/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tu,union\t/union names/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_KIND_DESCRIPTION!C\tv,variable\t/variable definitions/")
        
        # Add field descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tinput\t/input file/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tname\t/tag name/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\tpattern\t/pattern/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_FIELD_DESCRIPTION\ttyperef\t/Type and name of a variable or typedef/")
        
        # Add extra descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tanonymous\t/Include tags for non-named objects like lambda/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tfileScope\t/Include tags of file scope/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_EXTRA_DESCRIPTION\tpseudo\t/Include pseudo tags/")
        
        # Add role descriptions
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigncall\t/called in foreign languages/")
        pseudo.append("!_TAG_ROLE_DESCRIPTION!C!function\tforeigndecl\t/declared in foreign languages/")
        
        return pseudo
    
    def _escape_pattern(self, pattern: str) -> str:
        """Escape pattern for tag file"""
        return pattern.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('/', '\\/')
